Screenshot 1:
### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reporter's annoyance is the inline "Newsletters" sign-up band on the usnews.com homepage, which stayed visible with the reporter's filters and that no existing rule covered. Adding `usnews.com###newsletters` to the Subscriptions section of the Annoyances filter hides exactly that block, and the bound review verified the symptom resolved with an intact page. ## Rule `usnews.com###newsletters` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported defect is an on-page newsletter subscription annoyance, not first-party advertising, a paywall, or an anti-adblock wall, so none of the instruction's no-rule rules applies. The instruction's shared-rule guidance was checked:⁠ search_rules found no shared multi-domain rule for this element, and the site's own `#newsletters` id is site-specific, so a per-site rule in the file that already holds usnews.com subscription rules is the correct placement. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/ef35cf812a4b2d1e7ba178006c92da5cbd16b124/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
